questions.los: Determining the functional currency → selecting the translation method
questions.stem: A foreign subsidiary operates autonomously: it sets sales prices, purchases, and financing in the local currency, and its cash flows are essentially not remitted to the parent. On this basis, its functional currency is determined to be the local currency. When the parent translates the subsidiary's financial statements for consolidation, it should use:

choices.B: The temporal method
choices.C: Either method, at management's discretion

explanations.A: 对。判定链条：功能货币 = 当地货币（≠ 母公司报告货币）→ translation → current rate method。记法：'谁是功能货币听谁的'——功能货币是当地货币就用 current rate 整体折算。
explanations.B: 错。Temporal method 用于功能货币 = 母公司报告货币的场景（子公司只是母公司的延伸，如销售办事处），此时做的是 remeasurement 而非 translation。本题所有经营特征都指向自主实体。
explanations.C: 错。方法选择不是会计政策选择，而是由功能货币判定强制决定的。认为可自选是对该框架最根本的误解。

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Multinational Operations, determining the functional currency and selecting the translation method

questions.los: Temporal vs. current rate method: exchange rate applied to each financial statement item
questions.stem: When translating a subsidiary's financial statements using the current rate method, which of the following items is NOT translated at the period-end current exchange rate?

choices.B: Common stock
choices.C: Accounts payable

explanations.A: 错。Current rate method 下所有资产（含存货）都用期末现行汇率——这正是它与 temporal method 的区别；存货用历史汇率是 temporal method 的规则，两法记串是本考点头号陷阱。
explanations.B: 对。Current rate method 的例外项：股本类权益项目用历史汇率（发行日汇率），股利用宣告日汇率。正因为资产负债用现行汇率而股本用历史汇率，差额才需要 CTA 来配平。记法：'资产负债全现行，股本历史，损益平均，轧差进 CTA'。
explanations.C: 错。应付账款是负债，current rate method 下全部资产与负债一律用期末现行汇率。

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Multinational Operations, exchange rates applied to each item under the current rate method

questions.los: Exposure under the two methods (net asset vs. net monetary) and where the gain/loss is reported (P&L vs. CTA/OCI)
questions.stem: Under the temporal method, the parent's translation exposure to the subsidiary is the subsidiary's:

choices.B: Net monetary asset or liability position
choices.C: Total asset position

explanations.A: 错。净资产头寸是 current rate method 的 exposure——该法下全部资产负债都随现行汇率变动，敞口就是两者之差（权益）。两法的 exposure 定义互换是最常见混淆。
explanations.B: 对。Temporal method 下只有货币性项目（现金、应收、应付、长期债务）按现行汇率重新计量，非货币性项目锁定在历史汇率，所以敞口只剩净货币头寸。典型公司货币负债多于货币资产 → net monetary liability exposure。记法：'temporal 只动货币项，敞口自然是净货币'。
explanations.C: 错。总资产不是任何一种方法的 exposure 定义；敞口永远是'随汇率重估的项目'的净额，不是全部资产。

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Multinational Operations, balance sheet exposure under the two methods

questions.los: Temporal vs. current rate method: exchange rate applied to each financial statement item
questions.stem: A subsidiary is translated using the temporal method (FIFO costing). Beginning inventory is LC100 (exchange rate at purchase $0.80/LC), purchases during the period are LC500 (average rate $0.85/LC), ending inventory is LC120 (exchange rate at purchase $0.90/LC), and the period-end current rate is $0.92/LC. Translated COGS is closest to:

explanations.A: 对。Temporal method 下 COGS 各成分跟随对应存货的历史汇率：期初存货用其购入汇率、采购用当期平均、期末存货用其购入汇率，逐项折算后相减。这是 temporal 法'非货币项目配套历史汇率'规则在利润表的延伸。
explanations.B: 错。$408 = LC480 × 0.85，把整个 COGS 一揽子按平均汇率折算——这是 current rate method 的做法，temporal 法下 COGS 不能直接用平均汇率。
explanations.C: 错。$432 = LC480 × 0.90，错用了期末存货的历史汇率折算全部 COGS；期末存货汇率只用于折算期末存货本身。

steps.label: Formula
steps.content: Temporal method: translated COGS = BI×historical rate(BI) + Purchases×average rate − EI×historical rate(EI); in LC terms, COGS = 100 + 500 − 120 = LC480

steps.label: Trap
steps.content: Do not translate as a lump sum using 480×average (=408) or 480×ending-inventory rate (=432); under the temporal method, each component of COGS must be matched to its own historical rate

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Multinational Operations, translating COGS under the temporal method

questions.los: Exposure under the two methods (net asset vs. net monetary) and where the gain/loss is reported (P&L vs. CTA/OCI)
questions.stem: A subsidiary's functional currency is the local currency LC. Its net assets remain unchanged at LC2,000 all year (no earnings and no dividends during the year). The exchange rate depreciates from $0.50/LC at the beginning of the year to $0.45/LC at year-end. The translation effect for the year is:

choices.A: A $100 translation loss, recorded in the CTA within OCI
choices.B: A $100 translation loss, recorded in current-period P&L
choices.C: A $100 translation gain, recorded in the CTA within OCI

explanations.A: 对。功能货币 = 当地货币 → current rate method，exposure = 净资产 LC2,000；LC 贬值使净资产的美元价值缩水 2,000×(0.45−0.50) = −$100，且 current rate method 的折算损益全部进 OCI（CTA），不碰 P&L。记法：'current rate → CTA'，首字母都是 C。
explanations.B: 错。金额对但归属错：折算损益进 P&L 是 temporal method（remeasurement gain/loss）的处理；current rate method 下永远走 OCI/CTA。
explanations.C: 错。方向反了：子公司持有净资产（正敞口）而 LC 贬值，美元价值下降是损失。'持有该货币的净敞口 × 该货币贬值 = 损失'，方向判断永远从敞口正负出发。

steps.label: Formula
steps.content: Change in CTA ≈ net asset exposure × (ending rate − beginning rate) (simplified case where net assets are constant all year)

steps.label: Result
steps.content: −$100, i.e., a $100 loss, recorded in the CTA within OCI

steps.label: Trap
steps.content: Two common errors: recording the CTA in P&L (that is the temporal method); and misjudging a positive exposure plus a depreciating currency as a gain

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Multinational Operations, computing and reporting the CTA under the current rate method

questions.los: Accounting for hyperinflation (IFRS restate vs. US GAAP temporal)
questions.stem: A subsidiary operates in a hyperinflationary economy (cumulative inflation over three years exceeds 100%). The requirements under IFRS and US GAAP, respectively, for translating its financial statements are:

choices.A: IFRS: first restate the statements for inflation, then translate at the current rate; US GAAP: treat the functional currency as the parent's presentation currency and apply the temporal method
choices.B: IFRS: apply the temporal method; US GAAP: first restate for inflation, then translate at the current rate
choices.C: Both standards require applying the current rate method directly, with no adjustment

explanations.A: 对。IFRS (IAS 29) 思路是'先修数字再折算'：用物价指数重述至期末购买力，再全额按现行汇率折算；US GAAP 思路是'绕开当地货币'：直接把母公司报告货币当作功能货币，用 temporal method 重新计量。记法：'IFRS restate，GAAP temporal'。
explanations.B: 错。把两套准则的处理整个记反了——这是本考点唯一但致命的陷阱，考试就考你有没有记串。
explanations.C: 错。恶性通胀下直接用 current rate 折算会让历史成本资产在报告货币中被严重低估（'消失的资产'问题），两套准则都不允许不做调整。

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Multinational Operations, accounting for hyperinflationary economies

questions.los: Effect of the two methods on ratios (invariance of pure BS/IS ratios)
questions.stem: After a subsidiary's statements are translated into the parent's currency using the current rate method, which of the following ratios is unchanged from before translation (local-currency basis)?

choices.B: Total asset turnover
choices.C: ROA

explanations.A: 对。Current ratio 的分子分母都是资产负债表项目，current rate method 下全部按同一期末汇率折算，汇率在分子分母间约掉。规则：纯 BS 比率、纯 IS 比率折算后不变，混合比率会变。记法：'同表同率可约分'。
explanations.B: 错。Total asset turnover = 收入(平均汇率)/资产(期末汇率)，分子分母用了不同汇率，约不掉，属于混合比率，折算后会变。
explanations.C: 错。ROA = 净利润(平均汇率)/总资产(期末汇率)，同样是跨表混合比率，折算会改变其数值。

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Multinational Operations, effect of the current rate method on financial ratios

questions.los: DB plans: components and roll-forward of the PBO (service cost, interest cost, benefits paid)
questions.stem: A DB plan has a beginning pension obligation of 1,000 and a discount rate of 5%. During the year, current service cost is 80, benefits paid are 60, and an actuarial loss of 30 arises at year-end from a change in actuarial assumptions. The year-end pension obligation is closest to:

explanations.A: 对。期末义务 = 期初 + service cost + interest cost − benefits paid + 精算损失。记法：'两加一减一调整'——加新赚的（service）、加时间的（interest）、减付掉的（benefits）、精算损失加/利得减。
explanations.B: 错。1,070 漏加了精算损失 30。精算损失代表义务被重新估计得更大，必须计入期末义务（其归属 OCI 只是费用端的事，义务端照加）。
explanations.C: 错。1,220 把 benefits paid 加进了义务。支付退休金同时减少计划资产和 pension obligation——义务被清偿了一部分，方向是减。

steps.label: Formula
steps.content: Ending PBO = beginning PBO + service cost + beginning PBO×discount rate − benefits paid + actuarial loss

steps.label: Trap
steps.content: Benefits paid is a deduction, not an addition; the actuarial loss increases the obligation and must not be omitted just because it is reported in OCI

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Employee Compensation: Post-Employment and Share-Based, pension obligation roll-forward

questions.los: IFRS vs. US GAAP: reporting of the three components of periodic pension cost (P&L vs. OCI)
questions.stem: Under US GAAP: current service cost is 80, interest cost is 50, beginning plan assets are 900, the expected return on plan assets is 7%, and the actual return is 45. Ignoring any amortization, the pension expense recognized in P&L for the period is closest to:

explanations.A: 对。US GAAP 的 P&L 费用 = service cost + interest cost − expected return on plan assets = 80 + 50 − 900×7% = 67。GAAP 特色：用'预期'回报平滑费用，实际与预期之差进 OCI 慢慢消化。
explanations.B: 错。85 = 80 + 50 − 45，误用了 actual return。US GAAP 费用里扣的是 expected return（63），actual 与 expected 的差额 18 进 OCI，不直接冲当期费用。
explanations.C: 错。130 = 80 + 50，漏减了计划资产回报。计划资产的收益是养老金成本的天然抵减项，漏掉它会大幅高估费用。

steps.label: Formula
steps.content: US GAAP P&L pension expense = service cost + interest cost − expected return on plan assets

steps.label: Trap
steps.content: Use the expected, not the actual, return (the difference goes to OCI); omitting the return altogether gives 130

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Employee Compensation: Post-Employment and Share-Based, components of periodic pension cost under US GAAP

questions.los: IFRS vs. US GAAP: reporting of the three components of periodic pension cost (P&L vs. OCI)
questions.stem: Under IFRS: the beginning pension obligation is 1,000, the beginning fair value of plan assets is 800, the discount rate is 5%, and the company's long-term expected return on plan assets is 7%. The net interest cost recognized in P&L for the period is closest to:

explanations.A: 对。IFRS 用净额思路：net interest = (义务 − 计划资产) × 同一个折现率 = (1,000−800)×5% = 10。记法：'IFRS 一个率管到底'——义务增长和资产回报都按折现率算，预期回报率在 IFRS 下没有戏份。
explanations.B: 错。50 = 1,000×5%，只算了义务端利息、忘了用计划资产对冲。IFRS 是对净负债 (net pension liability) 计息，不是对义务单独计息。
explanations.C: 错。−6 = 1,000×5% − 800×7%，把 US GAAP 的 expected return（7%）搬进了 IFRS。IFRS 下计划资产的 P&L 回报强制按折现率 5% 计，超出部分属于 remeasurement 进 OCI。

steps.label: Formula
steps.content: IFRS net interest cost = (beginning obligation − beginning plan assets) × discount rate

steps.label: Trap
steps.content: IFRS does not use the expected return on plan assets; applying 7% gives −6, and counting only the interest on the obligation gives 50

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Employee Compensation: Post-Employment and Share-Based, computing net interest under IFRS

questions.los: Direction of the effect of assumption changes (discount rate / compensation growth rate) on the liability and expense
questions.stem: All else equal, if the discount rate used for a DB plan rises, the effects on the pension obligation and on current service cost, respectively, are:

choices.B: The obligation decreases, service cost increases
choices.C: The obligation increases, service cost decreases

explanations.A: 对。义务和 service cost 本质都是未来退休金支付的现值，折现率越高现值越小，所以双双下降。记法：'折现率是现值的天敌'。这也是公司想美化资产负债表时最常动的假设。
explanations.B: 错。service cost 是当年新增服务对应的未来给付的现值，同样受折现率压缩，不会反向上升。
explanations.C: 错。方向完全记反。注意区分：折现率上升时 interest cost 方向才是不确定的（率升×基数降），但义务和 service cost 的方向毫无悬念是降。

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Employee Compensation: Post-Employment and Share-Based, effect of the discount rate assumption

questions.los: Direction of the effect of assumption changes (discount rate / compensation growth rate) on the liability and expense
questions.stem: A company (US GAAP, final-pay DB plan) wants to lower the pension obligation reported on its balance sheet. Which of the following assumption changes would best achieve this?

choices.B: Increase the rate of compensation growth
choices.C: Increase the expected return on plan assets

explanations.A: 对。折现率上升直接压低未来给付的现值，义务下降。这是审计师和分析师最警惕的'一键美化'假设，题目问的方向务必与'现值反着折现率走'对上。
explanations.B: 错。final-pay 计划的给付随最终薪酬水平走，薪酬增长率越高、未来给付越大，义务是上升而非下降。
explanations.C: 错。这是本题的核心陷阱：expected return on plan assets 只影响 US GAAP 下的 P&L 费用平滑，完全不进入 obligation 的计量——义务的现值只由折现率、薪酬增长等给付端假设决定。想靠它降负债是徒劳的。

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Employee Compensation: Post-Employment and Share-Based, effect of actuarial assumptions on the liability and expense

questions.los: Share-based compensation: timing of expense recognition and measurement
questions.stem: A company grants employees stock options (equity-settled, with a 3-year service/vesting period). The measurement and recognition of the related compensation expense is:

choices.A: Measured at grant-date fair value and recognized over the 3-year service period, with no subsequent remeasurement for changes in the share price
choices.B: Remeasured at fair value each balance sheet date, with changes recognized in current-period expense
choices.C: Recognized in full at the exercise date based on intrinsic value

explanations.A: 对。Equity-settled 期权：grant date 用期权定价模型定下公允价值，此后锁定，在 vesting period 内直线摊销进费用。记法：'股结算，授予日定终身'。
explanations.B: 错。逐期重新计量是 cash-settled（如 SARs 现金结算）类负债型激励的处理——负债要随公允价值浮动，权益型不用。两类结算方式的计量规则最易混淆。
explanations.C: 错。行权日内在价值法是早已废弃的旧处理；现行准则下费用在服务期内确认，且用的是公允价值（含时间价值），不是行权时的内在价值。

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Employee Compensation: Post-Employment and Share-Based, measurement of share-based compensation

questions.los: Classification: mapping accounting methods to financial assets / associates / joint ventures / business combinations
questions.stem: A company holds 25% of the voting shares of another company, can appoint a representative to its board, and participates in operating decisions, but does not have control. The appropriate accounting treatment for this investment is:

choices.B: Fair value through profit or loss (FVPL)
choices.C: Full consolidation

explanations.A: 对。有重大影响 (significant influence) 但无控制 → associate → equity method。20%–50% 持股是重大影响的推定区间，派驻董事等事实证据进一步坐实。记法：'影响用权益，控制才合并，纯财务投资走公允'。
explanations.B: 错。FVPL 等金融资产处理适用于无重大影响的被动投资（通常 <20% 且无其他影响证据）；本题的董事会席位已明确构成重大影响。
explanations.C: 错。合并要求控制（通常 >50% 表决权或其他控制证据），25% 且'不构成控制'排除了合并。

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Intercorporate Investments, classifying investments and mapping accounting methods

questions.los: Classification: mapping accounting methods to financial assets / associates / joint ventures / business combinations
questions.stem: Two companies each hold 50% of a joint venture and share joint control. Under IFRS, the accounting treatment generally required of a venturer for its investment in the JV is:

choices.B: Proportionate consolidation
choices.C: Full consolidation with recognition of a 50% non-controlling interest

explanations.A: 对。IFRS 11 下 joint venture 必须用 equity method。共同控制意味着任何一方都不能单独控制，故不合并，只按权益法一行列报。
explanations.B: 错。比例合并是旧准则 (IAS 31) 曾允许的备选处理，现行 IFRS 11 已基本取消——这是新旧准则记串的经典陷阱。
explanations.C: 错。全面合并要求单方控制；共同控制下双方都不满足合并条件，也谈不上确认 NCI。

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Intercorporate Investments, accounting for joint ventures

questions.los: Equity method: initial recognition, investment income, dividends, and allocation of excess purchase price
questions.stem: At the beginning of the year, an investor purchases 30% of an investee for 300 (no excess purchase price) and uses the equity method. During the year the investee reports net income of 100 and declares and pays dividends of 40. The year-end carrying value of the investment is closest to:

explanations.A: 对。权益法账面价值 = 成本 + 份额利润 − 份额股利 = 300 + 30 − 12 = 318。记法：'利润加进来，股利抽出去'——股利是投资的收回，不是收益。
explanations.B: 错。330 漏减了股利份额 12。权益法下收到股利减少投资账面价值（收益早在确认份额利润时就入账了），漏减会导致收益被重复确认。
explanations.C: 错。290 = 300 + 30 − 40，减掉了被投资方的全额股利。持股 30% 只收到 40×30% = 12，所有份额计算都要乘持股比例。

steps.label: Formula
steps.content: Ending carrying value = initial cost + ownership %×NI − ownership %×dividends

steps.label: Trap
steps.content: Dividends must be deducted at the ownership share (not deducting → 330, deducting the full amount → 290); under the equity method dividends are not income

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Intercorporate Investments, equity method carrying-value roll-forward

questions.los: Equity method: initial recognition, investment income, dividends, and allocation of excess purchase price
questions.stem: An investor purchases 20% of an investee for 500. At the acquisition date the investee's net assets have a book value of 2,000 (the 20% share = 400). Of the excess purchase price of 100, 60 is attributable to undervalued PP&E (remaining life 10 years, straight-line depreciation) and the remaining 40 is goodwill. The investee reports net income of 150 for the year. The equity income the investor recognizes for the year is closest to:

explanations.A: 对。Equity income = 份额利润 − 超额购买价中可折旧部分的摊销 = 30 − 6 = 24。逻辑：投资方视角下 PP&E 成本更高，折旧也应更高，故调减份额利润。
explanations.B: 错。30 = 0.20×150，完全忽略了超额购买价摊销。只要题目给出 PP&E 低估与剩余年限，就必须做这步调整。
explanations.C: 错。20 = 30 − 100/10，把 40 的商誉也拿去按 10 年摊销了。权益法下内含商誉不摊销（只在整体投资减值测试中体现），只有归因于可折旧/可摊销资产的部分才摊。

steps.label: Formula
steps.content: Equity income = ownership %×NI − (excess purchase price attributable to depreciable assets ÷ remaining life)

steps.label: Trap
steps.content: The goodwill portion of 40 is not amortized (amortizing it → 20); omitting all amortization → 30

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Intercorporate Investments, allocation of excess purchase price under the equity method

questions.los: Full goodwill vs. partial goodwill
questions.stem: A parent acquires 80% of a subsidiary for 800. At the acquisition date the fair value of the subsidiary's identifiable net assets is 900, and the implied total fair value of the subsidiary based on the consideration paid is 1,000. The goodwill recognized under the partial goodwill method is closest to:

explanations.A: 对。Partial goodwill = 购买对价 − 持股比例×可辨认净资产公允价值 = 800 − 0.8×900 = 80。记法：'partial 只认自己那份'——只确认母公司份额对应的商誉，IFRS 允许此法。
explanations.B: 错。100 = 1,000 − 900，这是 full goodwill（整体公允价值减整体可辨认净资产），US GAAP 强制、IFRS 可选。两法数值差 = 归属 NCI 的商誉 20，别把两种口径记串。
explanations.C: 错。180 = 0.2×900，这是 partial 法下 NCI 的金额（少数股东按可辨认净资产份额计量），不是商誉。

steps.label: Formula
steps.content: Partial goodwill = consideration paid − ownership % × fair value of identifiable net assets

steps.label: Result
steps.content: 80 (for comparison: full goodwill = 1,000 − 900 = 100)

steps.label: Trap
steps.content: The 20 difference between full and partial is the NCI's share of goodwill; 0.2×900=180 is the NCI under the partial method, not goodwill

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Intercorporate Investments, computing full vs. partial goodwill

questions.los: Effect of the acquisition method vs. the equity method on reported ratios
questions.stem: For the same investment, if the acquisition method (full consolidation) is used rather than the equity method, the consolidated parent's net profit margin will generally be:

choices.B: Higher
choices.C: Unchanged

explanations.A: 对。两法下归属母公司股东的净利润相同，但合并把子公司收入全额并入，分母（revenue）变大、分子不变 → margin 被稀释。记法：'合并撑大分母，利润率必然变薄'；同理 ROA、ROE 在合并法下也更低。
explanations.B: 错。合并不会创造更高的利润率——利润没变、收入变大，方向只能向下。误选此项通常是把'收入更高'直接等同于'比率更好'。
explanations.C: 错。不变的是归母净利润的绝对额，不是利润率；只要收入口径变了，margin 就变。

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Intercorporate Investments, effect of the acquisition vs. equity method on ratios

questions.los: Impairment treatment (IFRS vs. US GAAP)
questions.stem: Which of the following correctly describes the subsequent measurement of goodwill recognized in a business combination?

choices.A: Amortized on a straight-line basis over its estimated useful life
choices.B: Not amortized; tested for impairment at least annually; once recognized, an impairment loss may not be reversed under either IFRS or US GAAP
choices.C: Not amortized; tested for impairment annually; if value subsequently recovers, the impairment may be reversed under IFRS

explanations.A: 错。商誉摊销是早已废止的旧处理；现行两套准则下商誉都是'不摊销 + 减值测试'模式。
explanations.B: 对。商誉每年（及出现减值迹象时）测试减值，且减值不可转回——这一点 IFRS 与 US GAAP 罕见地完全一致。记法：'商誉减值是单行道'。
explanations.C: 错。这是本题陷阱：IFRS 下多数长期资产的减值确实可以转回，但商誉是明文例外（IAS 36 禁止转回商誉减值），拿一般规则套商誉就中招。

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Intercorporate Investments, accounting for goodwill impairment

questions.los: Meaning of each dimension of the CAMELS framework
questions.stem: In the CAMELS framework for analyzing banks, the letter "S" stands for:

choices.B: Solvency
choices.C: Stability of operations

explanations.A: 对。CAMELS = Capital adequacy, Asset quality, Management, Earnings, Liquidity, Sensitivity to market risk。S 关注利率、汇率等市场因子变动对银行收益与资本的冲击。
explanations.B: 错。偿付能力的内容被 C（capital adequacy）覆盖，CAMELS 中没有单独的 Solvency 维度——用直觉英文单词硬凑是常见失分方式。
explanations.C: 错。Stability 不是 CAMELS 的组成部分；框架六个维度是固定的，考试就考精确对应。

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Analysis of Financial Institutions, the CAMELS framework

questions.los: Banks: capital adequacy (CET1/Tier1), liquidity (LCR/NSFR)
questions.stem: Under the Basel framework, the Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) measures a bank's:

choices.A: Whether its holdings of high-quality liquid assets (HQLA) can cover expected net cash outflows under a 30-day stress scenario
choices.B: The extent to which available stable funding covers required stable funding over a one-year horizon
choices.C: The extent to which CET1 capital covers risk-weighted assets

explanations.A: 对。LCR = HQLA ÷ 未来 30 天压力净现金流出 ≥ 100%，考察短期流动性抗压能力。记法：'LCR 管一个月，NSFR 管一年'。
explanations.B: 错。这是 NSFR (Net Stable Funding Ratio) 的定义——available stable funding / required stable funding，期限视角是一年。两个流动性指标的期限最易混淆。
explanations.C: 错。CET1/RWA 是资本充足率指标，属于 capital adequacy 维度，与流动性监管指标是两套体系。

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Analysis of Financial Institutions, LCR and NSFR

questions.los: Insurance: key ratios for P&C vs. life (combined ratio, etc.)
questions.stem: A P&C insurer has net premiums earned of 100, losses and loss adjustment expenses of 70, and underwriting expenses of 25. Its combined ratio and the underwriting conclusion are:

choices.B: 95%, an underwriting loss
choices.C: 70%, an underwriting profit

explanations.A: 对。Combined ratio = loss ratio + expense ratio = 70/100 + 25/100 = 95% < 100% → 承保端盈利。记法：'combined 过百就亏本'——100% 是承保盈亏平衡线。
explanations.B: 错。数值对但方向判反：combined ratio 低于 100% 表示保费足以覆盖赔付与费用，是盈利不是亏损。
explanations.C: 错。70% 只是 loss ratio，漏加了 expense ratio。combined ratio 必须同时纳入赔付端与费用端。

steps.label: Formula
steps.content: Combined ratio = (losses + LAE)/net premiums earned + underwriting expenses/net premiums earned

steps.label: Result
steps.content: 95%; <100% → underwriting profit

steps.label: Trap
steps.content: Using only the loss ratio gives 70%; the direction is judged against the 100% line, where lower is better

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Analysis of Financial Institutions, P&C combined ratio

questions.los: Banks: capital adequacy (CET1/Tier1), liquidity (LCR/NSFR)
questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT included in a bank's Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) capital?

choices.B: Retained earnings
choices.C: Preferred stock

explanations.A: 错（该项计入）。普通股是 CET1 的核心构成——CET1 的名字就叫 common equity。
explanations.B: 错（该项计入）。留存收益属于普通股股东权益，是 CET1 的标准组成部分。
explanations.C: 对。优先股不属于 common equity，符合条件的优先股计入的是 Additional Tier 1（合计构成 Tier 1）。陷阱在于'优先股也是权益'的直觉——资本分层看的是吸收损失的顺序，不是会计科目归属。

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Analysis of Financial Institutions, capital adequacy tiers CET1/AT1

questions.los: Distinguishing reporting quality from earnings quality, and the quality spectrum
questions.stem: A company's financial statements fully comply with GAAP and are adequately and neutrally disclosed, but this year's earnings come mainly from a one-time gain on the disposal of its headquarters building. The correct assessment of its reporting quality and earnings quality is:

choices.A: High reporting quality, low earnings quality
choices.B: Low reporting quality, high earnings quality
choices.C: Both are low

explanations.A: 对。报告质量看'信息是否合规、可信、决策有用'——本题满足；盈余质量看'盈利是否可持续、回报是否充足'——一次性处置收益不可持续，故盈余质量低。两者是频谱上的两个独立维度。记法：'报告看真不真，盈余看久不久'。
explanations.B: 错。方向颠倒：合规充分披露恰恰是高报告质量的定义；把'利润成色差'误安到报告质量头上，说明没分清两个概念的对象。
explanations.C: 错。低报告质量意味着报表本身不可信（如操纵、隐瞒），本题报表如实反映了一次性收益，报告质量并不低。

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Evaluating Quality of Financial Reports, the reporting quality and earnings quality spectrum

questions.los: Direction and meaning of the variables in the Beneish M-score / Altman Z-score
questions.stem: A company's Beneish M-score rises from −2.5 to −1.5. The correct interpretation of this change is:

choices.A: The probability of earnings manipulation has increased
choices.B: The probability of earnings manipulation has decreased
choices.C: The risk of financial distress (bankruptcy) has increased

explanations.A: 对。M-score 越高（越不负）→ 越像操纵者；经验阈值约 −1.78，−1.5 已越过警戒线。记法：'M 往上爬，Manipulation 概率大'。
explanations.B: 错。方向记反，通常是被 Altman Z-score 带偏——Z 是越高越安全，M 是越高越危险，两个模型的'好方向'正好相反。
explanations.C: 错。破产预测是 Altman Z-score 的领地（Z 越低破产风险越高）；M-score 只回答'报表像不像被操纵'，不预测破产。模型用途混淆是本考点第二大陷阱。

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Evaluating Quality of Financial Reports, interpreting the Beneish M-score

questions.los: Common manipulation techniques: revenue recognition, classification shifting, reserve management
questions.stem: An IFRS-reporting company changes the presentation of interest paid from operating activities (CFO) to financing activities (CFF) (IFRS permits this choice). The effect of this reclassification is:

choices.A: CFO increases, total cash flow is unchanged
choices.B: Both CFO and total cash flow increase
choices.C: No effect on CFO, because interest paid must be classified within operating activities

explanations.A: 对。分类腾挪 (classification shifting) 不创造一分钱现金，只是把流出挪出 CFO 口径，使 CFO 显得更强。分析师应还原口径再比较——CFO 突然改善但总现金流未变，就要查分类政策变更。
explanations.B: 错。重分类是零和搬运：CFO 多出来的正好是 CFF 少掉的，总现金流量不可能因列报位置改变而增加。
explanations.C: 错。'必须列 CFO'是 US GAAP 的规则；IFRS 恰恰允许 interest paid 选择 CFO 或 CFF——两套准则的现金流分类弹性差异正是这种腾挪的空间所在。

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Evaluating Quality of Financial Reports, cash flow classification shifting

questions.los: Cash flow quality signals
questions.stem: When assessing earnings quality, the correct judgment about the relationship between operating cash flow (CFO) and net income (NI) is:

choices.A: NI persistently and materially exceeding CFO (large positive accruals) is a warning signal for earnings quality
choices.B: As long as NI keeps growing, CFO being below NI is normal and warrants no attention
choices.C: CFO persistently exceeding NI is the typical signal of manipulated earnings

explanations.A: 对。NI 长期跑赢 CFO 意味着利润高度依赖应计项目 (accruals)，而应计的可持续性和可验证性都低于现金——高应计组合的后续回报与盈余持续性均更差。记法：'利润是观点，现金是事实'。
explanations.B: 错。恰恰是'NI 好看但收不到现金'的组合最需要警惕——增长的账面利润可能来自激进收入确认或少提准备。
explanations.C: 错。方向反了。CFO 稳定覆盖并超过 NI 通常是盈余质量好的表现（折旧等非现金费用压低 NI 属正常）；持续的高正应计才指向操纵风险。

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Evaluating Quality of Financial Reports, cash flow and accruals quality signals

questions.los: Using the extended DuPont decomposition to locate the problem
questions.module: Integration of Financial Statement Analysis Techniques
questions.stem: Five-factor DuPont data: tax burden (NI/EBT) = 0.75, interest burden (EBT/EBIT) = 0.90, EBIT margin = 20%, asset turnover = 1.2, financial leverage = 2.0. ROE is closest to:

explanations.A: 对。五因子连乘：0.75×0.90×0.20×1.2×2.0 = 32.4%。分解的意义是把 ROE 拆到税、利息、经营利润率、周转、杠杆五个环节定位问题源头。
explanations.B: 错。16.2% 漏乘了 leverage (×2.0)，等于只算到 ROA 口径再打了税息折扣——检查因子个数是否凑齐五个。
explanations.C: 错。43.2% 漏乘了 tax burden (×0.75)，即用税前口径冒充了 ROE；NI 才是 ROE 的分子，税负环节不能跳过。

steps.label: Formula
steps.content: ROE = (NI/EBT) × (EBT/EBIT) × (EBIT/Revenue) × (Revenue/Assets) × (Assets/Equity)

steps.label: Trap
steps.content: Omitting leverage gives 16.2%, omitting tax burden gives 43.2%; count the factors before hitting the calculator

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Integration of Financial Statement Analysis Techniques, five-factor DuPont decomposition

questions.los: Combined effect of accounting adjustments on ratios (off-balance-sheet items, stripping out equity-method results, etc.)
questions.module: Integration of Financial Statement Analysis Techniques
questions.stem: When assessing a company's core operating profitability, analysts often remove equity-method income from associates from net income before computing net profit margin, because:

choices.A: The share of the associates' profit is included in NI, but their revenue is not included in revenue, which systematically overstates the margin
choices.B: Equity-method income is unrealized income that should not be recognized under the accounting standards
choices.C: Removing it raises the margin, which better reflects management's performance

explanations.A: 对。权益法'一行合并'的结构性错位：分子含联营利润、分母不含联营收入，分子分母口径不一致，margin 虚高。剥离（NI 减去 equity income，必要时资产端同步剔除投资账面）后才是可比的核心经营利润率。
explanations.B: 错。Equity method 收益是准则要求确认的合法收益，不是未实现收益；剥离是分析性调整（口径统一），不是纠正会计错误。
explanations.C: 错。方向说反了：剔除只在分子做减法（收入不变），margin 通常下降而非上升——这正说明原口径被高估。

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Integration of Financial Statement Analysis Techniques, analytical adjustment of ratios for the equity method
